title: Accounting and Tax Services for Pet Sitting Businesses

rows.section: FAQ: Should I incorporate my pet sitting business?
rows.before: <div class="sb-faq-a">Incorporating gives you a separate legal entity, which matters in a business that holds client keys and works unsupervised inside occupied homes, plus roughly a 12.2% Ontario combined rate on the first $500,000 of active income under ITA section 125 against a personal rate up to 53.53% when unincorporated.
